semverGroups.label: Symbiote packages are pinned exactly. Their version lines move independently and a floating range has already been shown to break pod install upstream.
TypeScript stays on the 6.x line: typescript-eslint@8 peers a version below 6.1.0, so the TypeScript 7 line is not usable yet.
Caret ranges for everything else. Must stay last: syncpack applies the first matching group, so a catch-all placed first would shadow the rules above.
